data.long_meaning: The name Sallu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sala' which means 'little mountain'. This name is often used in Hindu culture and represents the strength and stability of a mountain. It is also associated with the sun and the moon, symbolizing the balance and harmony in nature. The name Sallu carries the meaning “Little Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sallu usually hope their child will grow to embody little mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sallu is believed to have spiritual significance in Hinduism. It is associated with the divine energy of the universe and is believed to bring strength, stability, and balance to the individual who bears this name.
data.etymology: Sallu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sallu total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sallu is deeply rooted in Hindu culture, especially in the state of Maharashtra, India. It is a common name in the Marathi community and holds great significance in the region's folklore and mythology. One of the popular legends associated with the name is of a powerful warrior king named Sallva Bharuha, who is known for his bravery and strength. The name Sallu is also a gentle reminder of the robust and unyielding spirit of the Marathi people.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, mountains are considered sacred and are believed to be the dwelling places of various gods and goddesses. The name Sallu, therefore, carries a spiritual significance that honors the divine presence of the mountains and the sense of stability and balance they bring to our lives. It also represents the inner strength and resilience that we need to face the challenges of life with courage and grace. Just as a mountain stands firm against the test of time, the name Sallu inspires us to be steadfast and unwavering in our beliefs and values.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Sallu finds its origin in the Sanskrit word "Sala", which means "calm" or "peaceful". It is a name that embodies inner tranquility and serenity, reflecting the deep spiritual connection of the individual to their inner self and the universe. The name serves as a reminder to stay grounded and centered, even in the midst of life's challenges.

historical_references.reference: Sallu was a prominent Maratha military commander during the reign of Chhatrapati Shahuji Maharaj (1707-1749 CE). He is known for leading the forces that defeated the Mughal army at the Battle of Parasikad in 1737.

Sallu Bhatia was a Jain merchant and an influential figure in the 13th-14th century Gujarat. He was a patron of the poet and philosopher Hemachandra Suri and is credited with the construction of several Jain temples in the region.
